title: T015 — %expr variable without a bindings object
purpose: A %expr formula that names a variable but is given no bindings object fails to compile.
trigger: %expr formula 'a + b' uses variables but no bindings object is passed.
fix: Pass the bindings object as the second argument, e.g. %expr "a + b" @.v.
notes: Bindings are explicit: variables resolve under the object passed as the second argument (a reads @.v.a), and a formula with variables requires one.
Compilation fails at parse time with the T015 code; the message names the unbound variable.
